name: wine-loongos
title: Je-Wine
runtime: Shared component installer: Box64 + Wine + environment-selected graphics
launcher: Bundled ARM64 Python + native SDL2/SDL2_ttf; no system Python or PortMaster required

portmaster.desc: Windows game runner with separate device families, environment providers and resource-free game adapter packages.
portmaster.inst: Extract the SD-card archives at the card root. Canonical entries are in roms/windows; roms/ports contains bridges. Supply complete Windows game files in roms/windows/<id>/data. Shared runtime is installed under .winecellar.

notes: ROCKNIX Windows SD-card layout with controlled bottle.json loading; this is not a PortMaster autoinstall ZIP. Private ARM64 launcher environment, shared Wine components and resource-free game adapters remain separate under roms/windows. Ports scripts are thin homepage bridges. Only the registered MiniLoong firmware has a machine environment; layout compatibility does not imply ROCKNIX firmware support. Installation and fullscreen handoff are locally checked, not revalidated on a device.
